blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While the language model backbone is pretrained on text alone, large audio-language models (LALMs) can, to a great extent, recognize acoustic attributes, such as emotion, speaker gender, and spoken language. However, it is unclear how the audio representation is integrated, if at all, with the other text representation before the model produces text. We hypothesize that there is a shared subspace where the audio and text representations are aligned. To test this hypothesis, we identify cross-modal neurons that are responsible for representing both audio and text. We find alignment between audio and text neurons to various degrees across three LALMs and four acoustic attribute types. Causal interventions, steering and deactivating the neurons, confirm that the cross-modal neurons are not just necessary for prediction but can also be manipulated.
blocks.zh: 虽然语言模型主干部分被预先训练在文本上,但大型音频语言模型(LALMs)在很大程度上可以识别声学属性,如情感,演说者性别和口语. 但是,不清楚在模型产生文本之前,音频表述如何与其它文本表述融合,如果有的话。 我们假设,有一个共享的子空间,音频和文本的表达一致。 为了测试这个假说,我们发现了负责代表音频和文本的跨模式神经元. 我们发现音频和文本神经元之间 不同程度的对齐 跨越三个LALM和四个声学属性类型。 致病干预,引导和解除神经元,证实跨模式神经元不仅是预测所必需的,也可以被操纵.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
There are increasingly many large audio-language models (LALMs)
that process acoustic input directly through an LLM
backbone ( Chu et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ) , enabling
tasks such as speaker, emotion, and spoken-language identification from raw
audio ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Sakshi et al., 2025 ) .
Since the representations of an LALM’s LLM backbone originate from
text pretraining, this raises a fundamental question: how does a backbone
whose representations were built for text come to recognize acoustic attributes?
It is less likely that the audio representation remains
separate from the text representation given how the LLM backbone is trained.
If the audio representation is integrated with the text representation,
there should exist a joint space where the audio and the text representations
are aligned.
In this work, we hypothesize that LALMs recognize acoustic attributes
through such an audio-text alignment .

Interpretability work on LALMs has approached related questions
from several angles: tracking how attribute information evolves
across layers ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) ,
locating attention heads that govern how much the model attends
to audio ( Glazer et al., 2026 ) , and identifying individual
neurons with attribute-specific function,
such as for emotion ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) .
One line of work shows that audio-language models project the linguistic
content of speech (what is being said) into a representation aligned
with the text embedding space ( Ògúnrèmí et al., 2025 ) . These studies
either analyze the audio on its own or relate speech content,
rather than paralinguistic or speaker attributes, to text.
These results tell us little about whether and how audio representations
are integrated with text representations.

The work closest to answering our question is the Semantic Hub
hypothesis ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , which assumes that multimodal LLMs
route heterogeneous inputs, including acoustic signals such as animal
sounds, through a shared, text-anchored semantic space.
Their evidence, limited to a single LALM and to non-speech sounds,
rests on cosine similarity between vectors in the ambient space (i.e., the entire hidden vectors).

blocks.en:
Most dimensions of vectors in the ambient space, however, carry information unrelated
to any particular label, such as neurons that are highly active for every
input ( Sun et al., 2024 ) .
A high cosine similarity does not show that the label itself
is shared, and a low one does not rule it out.
In fact, in our experiments with three LALMs (§ 4.1 ), cosine similarity
barely tells matching from mismatching audio-text label pairs apart, and
label-independent dimensions account for 88 % 88\% – 100 % 100\% of its variance.
A semantic hub, if it exists, should therefore be sought
in specific dimensions rather than across all dimensions of the representation.
We thus compare only a few dimensions in audio and in text,
those most relevant to each label, instead of the entire vectors.
This keeps the comparison from being dominated by dimensions
unrelated to the label and pinpoints the specific dimensions that carry
the alignment for causal interventions.

blocks.en: Across three LALMs (Qwen2.5-Omni, DeSTA2.5-Audio, and Audio Flamingo 3) and four attribute types (animal sound, emotion, gender, and spoken language), we find: • The alignment exists but is hidden from cosine similarity. Label-specific audio and text neurons coincide far more for matching than for mismatching labels, whereas cosine similarity barely tells matching from mismatching labels apart (§ 4.1 , § 4.2 ). • Interventions defined from text change recognition from audio. Shifting cross-modal concept neurons along a text-derived direction raises the target answer significantly more than random neurons for 35 of 48 labels in Qwen2.5-Omni and Audio Flamingo 3 (7 of 24 in DeSTA2.5-Audio), and can make Qwen2.5-Omni report “happy” for every silent input ( 20 % 20\% without steering; best random set 45 % 45\% ; § 4.3 ). • Recognition relies on cross-modal concept neurons. Deactivating them impairs the target task before unrelated tasks in all 8 task combinations of Qwen2.5-Omni and Audio Flamingo 3 (2 of 4 in DeSTA2.5-Audio), with only 0.2 0.2 – 0.7 % 0.7\% of FFN neurons in Qwen2.5-Omni, and is as damaging as deactivating the most audio-specific neurons although they are less audio-specific (§ 4.4 ). DeSTA2.5-Audio’s weaker effects may partly reflect the ASR transcript it also receives.

2 Cross-Modal Concept Neurons
blocks.zh: 2 跨相模概念

blocks.en:
To understand whether audio and text are mapped to a shared
subspace, we study audio recordings of a particular attribute paired with text descriptions of it.
Consider, for example, the emotion attribute angry .
We run two forward passes through an LALM, one with
a speech utterance of an angry voice followed by
the question “What is the emotional tone of the speaker
in the audio?” and the other with only a text description of the label,
“The speaker feels angry”, i.e., the answer we would expect.
If there is a shared subspace for both audio
and text, then the two forward passes should produce
representations with a sufficient overlap.
For the rest of this section, we will describe
how we construct the audio and text representations
and how the overlap of the two is defined.

blocks.en:
Following the key-value memory view of the Transformer
feed-forward (FFN) layer ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , the first weight matrix
of an FFN layer defines a set of keys: each row is compared against a
token’s residual-stream representation, and the resulting value, after
a nonlinearity, is what we call a neuron’s activation, the strength
with which that token matches this particular key. The second FFN
weight matrix defines a corresponding set of values: each neuron’s
activation scales how much of its associated value vector is written
back into the residual stream. Each neuron thus signals whether a fixed
direction is active, making neurons a fine-grained unit for testing
whether audio and text share such directions, as in neuron-level analyses
of text ( Geva et al., 2022 ; Dai et al., 2022 ) and speech
models ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We study three modern LALMs that combine an audio encoder with a text-pretrained LLM backbone: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , DeSTA2.5-Audio ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and Audio Flamingo 3 ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) . Qwen2.5-Omni and Audio Flamingo 3 update their backbone (Qwen2.5-7B) on audio-text data, whereas DeSTA2.5-Audio keeps its backbone (Llama-3.1-8B) frozen and aligns audio to it through a trained adapter. DeSTA2.5-Audio also feeds its backbone a Whisper transcript of the audio as text tokens whenever speech is detected; our audio-side activations (§ 2 ) exclude these tokens. We return to these differences in § 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们研究三个现代的LALM,将音频编码器和文本预导的LLM主干线结合起来: Wen2.5-Omni-7B (徐等,2025年),DeSTA2.5-Audio (Lu等,2026年)和Audio Flamingo 3(Ghosh等,2025年). Quen2.5-Omni和Audio Flamingo 3在音频文本数据上更新了它们的骨干(Quen2.5-7B),而DeSTA2.5-Audio则保持了它的骨干(Llama-3.1-8B)被冷冻并透过训练有素的适配器来给它配音. DeSTA2.5-Audio也为它的骨干提供语音的Whisper笔录,作为每当发现语音时的文字符号;我们的音频侧活化(§2)排除了这些符号. 我们回到第4.4节中的这些分歧。

blocks.en:
We draw our four attribute-recognition tasks from the SAKURA benchmark ( Yang et al., 2025b ) : emotion (5 labels: disgust, sad, angry, fear, happy), animal sound (9 labels: cat, cow, crow, dog, frog, hen, pig, rooster, sheep), gender (2 labels: female, male), and spoken language (8 labels: Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish). We use all 500 audio instances of each task with SAKURA’s single-hop multiple-choice questions.
For every label, we write five paraphrased text descriptions (e.g., “The speaker feels angry.”, “This is an angry voice.”; full list in Appendix B.10 ), so that the text side is not tied to one surface form. This audio-text pairing per label is what “cross-modal” refers to.

blocks.en: 4.1 Cosine Similarity Barely Reveals the Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 余弦相近性 勉强揭示对齐

blocks.en: We first ask whether the alignment is visible in representational similarity, as used in prior work. For each label c c , we concatenate its pooled per-layer FFN activations (§ 2 ) across all layers, μ m ​ ( c ) = [ μ 1 m ​ ( c ) ; … ; μ L m ​ ( c ) ] \mu^{m}(c)=[\mu_{1}^{m}(c);\ldots;\mu_{L}^{m}(c)] , separately for audio and text. Comparing every audio label’s vector against every text label’s vector with cosine similarity gives a label-by-label matrix whose diagonal holds matched pairs (e.g. audio “dog” vs. text “dog”) and whose off-diagonal holds mismatched pairs (e.g. audio “dog” vs. text “cat”). To quantify how clearly this matrix separates matched from mismatched pairs, we decompose its variance, as in a two-way analysis of variance ( Montgomery, 2017 ) , into label-independent row and column offsets (a label similar to every label of the other modality) and a matched-label component, the extra similarity of the diagonal entries. The matched-label variance share asks how much of the variation among the matrix’s entries comes simply from whether the audio and text labels match, rather than from some labels being similar to everything (the offsets) or from noise. It is 100 % 100\% for a matrix that is a uniform bright diagonal on a flat background, and 0 % 0\% when matched pairs are no more similar than mismatched ones (formula in Appendix A.1 ). Being a proportion, it can also be computed for the neuron-level overlap matrix of § 4.2 and compared with the cosine share of the same model and task.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: A parallel line of work studies how multimodal LLMs that pair a vision encoder with a text-pretrained backbone process visual information internally. Goh et al. (2021) first showed that individual neurons in CLIP fire for the same concept whether it appears as an image or as text, coining the term “multimodal neuron.” Schwettmann et al. (2023) found similar neurons inside a frozen, text-only LLM backbone augmented with a vision encoder: FFN neurons that translate projected visual features into the corresponding text concept in the residual stream, with an ablation showing a causal effect on captioning. None of this work looks at audio, or steers these neurons via activation intervention, the question central to § 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 平行的工作线研究如何将视觉编码器与文本预选主干线过程的视觉信息联系起来的多式LLMs内部. Goh等人(2021年)首先表明,CLIP火中单个神经元对于同一个概念,无论是作为图像还是文字出现,都铸造出"多模式神经元"一词. Schwetmann等人(2023年)在被冷冻的、只带文字的LLM主干内发现了类似的神经元,并用视觉编码器加以增强: FFN神经元,将所预测的视觉特征翻译为剩余流中相应的文字概念,其衰变显示出对字幕的因果关系. 这些工作都不看音频,或通过激活干预引导这些神经元,这个问题是第4.3节的核心。

blocks.en: Beyond the layer-, attention-head-, and neuron-level analyses discussed in § 1 , recent work has tested whether a spoken answer becomes “readable” from a middle layer before the model commits to it ( Fan et al., 2026 ) . Other work traced which internal pathway wins when audio and text evidence conflict, along the way reporting, via cosine similarity, that the two converge in later layers ( Cho et al., 2026 ) . None of these studies identifies individually shared audio-and-text units and tests both whether steering them changes the model’s behavior and whether it relies on them.
blocks.zh: 除了第1节所讨论的层外, 注意力头和神经元层面的分析, 最近的工作测试了一个口语答案是否在模型承诺之前从中层变成“可读性”(Fan等, 2026年)。 其他工作追踪到当音频和文本证据发生冲突时哪些内部路径胜出,沿途通过同位素相似性报告两者在后层汇合(Cho等人,2026年)。 这些研究中没有一个能够确定个人共享的音频和文本单元,并测试引导它们是否改变模型的行为以及它是否依赖于它们。

blocks.en: Beyond audio, Wu et al. (2025) also study multilingual models, where inputs in different languages share representations anchored in the dominant training language. Their evidence rests on cosine similarity over vectors in the ambient space, not on individual neurons (§ 1 ), and their causal test adds the difference between two word unembeddings at one layer, a steering test only; we additionally test deactivation, in three LALMs and on both speech and non-speech attributes.
blocks.zh: 除了音频, Wu等人(2025年)也研究多语种模式,不同语言的投入共享以主流培训语言为主的表述. 其证据依赖于在环境空间对向量的同位素相近性,而不是单个神经元(§ 1),其因果测试增加了两个单词在一层上不嵌入的区别,仅是方向测试;另外,我们还测试了在三个LALM以及语音和非语音属性上的失能.

blocks.en: Representing one concept with a single unit shared across different surface forms has been tested causally elsewhere: Brinkmann et al. (2025) found that ablating a shared unit knocks out a grammatical concept across many typologically distinct languages while a language-specific unit barely matters. Nakai et al. (2026) focus on neurons that control the output language of speech–text models: they identify language-selective neurons separately from speech and text inputs and steer generation through the output-language neurons, whereas the neurons that represent the input language across modalities are compared only by overlap, without testing whether the model relies on them. They also study language identity only, whereas we also cover paralinguistic and non-speech attributes.
blocks.zh: 代表一个具有不同表面形式共享的单一单位的概念,在别处也经过了因果测试:Brinkmann等人(2025年)发现,将一个共享单位打碎在许多类型不同的语言中,而语言特定单位几乎不重要。 中井等编. (2026)关注控制语音-文本模型输出语言的神经元:它们从语音和文本输入中分别识别语言选择性神经元,并通过输出语言神经元引导生成,而代表不同模式的输入语言的神经元则只能通过重叠来比较,而不测试模型是否依赖它们. 他们也只研究语言特性,而我们也涵盖准语言和非语言属性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: LALMs recognize acoustic attributes through an alignment between audio and text that cosine similarity over entire representations barely reveals but individual FFN neurons expose: the neurons most specific to an attribute in audio and in text coincide, label by label. This alignment is truly cross-modal, since a direction computed from text steers what the model recognizes from audio (§ 4.3 ), and recognition relies on it, since removing cross-modal concept neurons selectively impairs the attribute (§ 4.4 ). How strongly a model relies on the alignment varies across models.
blocks.zh: LALMs通过音频和文本之间的对接来识别出声学属性,在整个表达方式上,同位素的相似性几乎不显出,但单个FFN神经元暴露出:在音频和文本相通中,对一个属性最具体的神经元,通过标签来进行标签. 这种一致确实是跨模式的,因为从文本中计算出的方向引导着该模式从音频中识别的内容(§ 4.3),而识别依赖于它,因为删除跨模式概念神经元有选择地损害属性(§ 4.4)。 模型对调整的依赖程度因模型而异。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our attributes and materials come entirely from the SAKURA benchmark: four fixed attribute sets and text descriptions we authored ourselves (§ 3 ); each label’s text side consists of five templated paraphrases. A much larger prompt set per label is hard to construct without introducing label-specific wording that would itself confound the comparison across labels, so we instead use templates shared by every label of a task that differ only in the label word.
blocks.zh: 我们的属性和材料完全出自SAKURA基准:我们自己编写的四套固定属性集和文字描述(§3);每个标签的文本侧由五个模板解说组成. 每个标签中一个大得多的快件集很难构造,如果不引入特定标签的措辞,它本身会混淆标签之间的比较,因此我们使用每个标签共享的模板,这个任务只在标签单词上有所不同.

blocks.en: Three LALMs is not an exhaustive sample of current architectures. In particular, DeSTA2.5-Audio differs from the other two models at once in its frozen backbone, its backbone family, and its transcript input, so explaining its weaker effects beyond the transcript route for spoken language would require more models.
blocks.zh: 三种LALM并不是当前建筑的详尽样本. 特别是,DeSTA2.5-Audio在其被冻结的骨干,骨干家族,以及笔录输入中同时不同于其他两种模型,因此解释其较弱的效果超出口语的笔录路线需要更多的模型.

We did not locate these windows on the validation split, which holds as few as 8 samples per label, too few to identify a sustained 10% accuracy decline reliably. The selection uses a different intervention and outcome (deactivation, task accuracy) from those of the steering test (steering, target rate), so it does not directly optimize the steering result, and every random control set is matched to the same neuron-set size.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work is purely diagnostic: we analyze the internal representations of three existing, publicly released pretrained LALMs using an existing public benchmark (SAKURA), and we neither collect new data, train new models, nor release any new model weights or fine-tuned checkpoint. The four attributes we study, animal-sound, emotion, gender, and spoken-language identification, are recognition capabilities already present in each model’s public release; our steering and deactivation interventions (§ 4.3 , § 4.4 ) are used strictly as scientific probes to test whether specific neurons can steer, or are necessary for, this existing behavior, not as a proposed technique for modifying or improving deployed systems. We therefore do not foresee this work introducing risks beyond those already inherent in the publicly released models and benchmark it studies.
blocks.zh: 这项工作纯粹是诊断性的:我们用现有的公共基准(SAKURA)来分析三种已公开发布的预训LALM的内部表现,我们既不收集新数据,训练新模型,也不释放出任何新的模型权重或微调检查站. 我们研究的四个属性,动物声,情感,性别和口语识别,是每个模型的公开发布中已经存在的识别能力;我们的引导和失能干预(§ 4.3,§ 4.4)被严格地用作科学探针,以测试特定的神经元能否引导或是否是这一现有行为所必需的,而不是作为修改或改进部署系统的一种拟议技术. 因此,我们没有预见到这项工作将带来超出其研究的公开发布模式所固有的风险。

blocks.en: Because each label’s text prompts contain the label word itself (e.g. “The speaker feels angry.”), a cross-modal concept neuron set could in principle reflect the literal label word rather than the attribute. To test this, we re-extract Qwen2.5-Omni’s text activations for the emotion task with the same five templates but the label word replaced by a synonym sharing no token with it (angry → \to furious, happy → \to joyful, sad → \to sorrowful, fear → \to terror, disgust → \to revulsion), re-identify cross-modal concept neurons at k ∈ { 1,000 , 2 , 000 , 4 , 000 } k\in\{1{,}000,2{,}000,4{,}000\} , and repeat the task-level deactivation of § 4.4 . blocks.en: B.6 Audio-Position Control
blocks.zh: B.6 音频设备控制

blocks.en: Both interventions are applied at every token position, so part of their effect could come from disrupting how the model reads the question rather than how it processes the audio. We therefore repeat both on Qwen2.5-Omni’s emotion task, the same setting as the synonym control, restricting the intervention to each sample’s audio-token positions. Deactivation remains selective: the target task’s decline onset moves from N = 1,618 N=1{,}618 to 12,804 12{,}804 and the control tasks’ from 71,812 71{,}812 to 189,409 189{,}409 , the control tasks are nearly unaffected until N = 71,812 N=71{,}812 , and at N = 1,618 N=1{,}618 and 12,804 12{,}804 target accuracy is below all five random-neuron control trials, whose neurons are likewise deactivated only at audio-token positions. For steering, the cross-modal concept neuron set outranks all five random sets for all five labels (rank test p = 1.3 × 10 − 4 p=1.3\times 10^{-4} ) and is significant for four of them under the prediction-interval test; its lead over the random sets in average target rate is 54 54 – 82 % 82\% as large as under whole-sequence steering. This holds even for silent input, which carries no acoustic content: at λ = 5 \lambda=5 the cross-modal concept neuron set’s target rate exceeds every random set’s for all five labels, reaching 100 % 100\% for “happy” against at most 30 % 30\% for the random sets. Restricting the interventions to audio positions thus weakens both effects, but leaves their selectivity, their advantage over random neurons, and hence our conclusions unchanged.
blocks.zh: 这两种发言都应用在每个象征性位置,因此其部分效果可能来自对模型如何读取问题而不是如何处理音频的干扰. 因此,我们重复了Quen2.5-Omni的情感任务,与同义词控制相同的设定,将干预限制在每一个样本的音频位置上。 解除作用仍然有选择性:目标任务的衰减发端由N=1,618 N=1{,}618至12,804 12{,}804,以及控制任务从71,812 71{,}812至189,409 189{,}409,控制任务几乎没有受到影响,直到N=71,812 N=711{,}812,在N=1,618 N=1{,}和12,804 12{,}804 目标精确度低于所有五个随机中微子控制试验,其神经元同样只在音频切入位置被关闭. 对于指向,跨模式概念神经元对所有五个标签(等级测试p=1.3×10 – 4 p=1.3\times 10×4})的所有五个随机集进行了排行榜,在预测-间距测试下,对其中四个都很重要;在平均目标率下,它相对于随机集的领先是54 54 — 82 % 与整个序列引导下一样大. 即使静默输入, 也不会包含任何音响内容: 在 QQ = 5\lambda = 5 时, 跨模式概念神经元集的目标率超过所有五个标签的每个随机集的目标率, “ 幸福” 则达到 100 % , 而随机集最多为 30 % 。 因此,将发言限制在音频位置会削弱这两种效果,但保留其选择性、相对于随机神经元的优势,因此我们的结论保持不变。

blocks.en: B.7 Layer-Matched Random Control
blocks.zh: B.7 由层组成的随机控件

blocks.en: Cross-modal concept neurons concentrate in later layers ( 48 48 – 73 % 73\% of each Qwen2.5-Omni emotion set lies in the last quarter of the layers), whereas the random sets of § 4.3 are drawn uniformly across layers, so the cross-modal concept neuron set’s advantage could in principle reflect only where its neurons sit. We therefore repeat the steering test on Qwen2.5-Omni’s emotion task, the same setting as the other controls, with five random sets that match the cross-modal concept neuron set’s number of neurons in every layer. The cross-modal concept neuron set outranks all five layer-matched random sets for all five labels (rank test p = 1.3 × 10 − 4 p=1.3\times 10^{-4} ) and is significant for four of them under the prediction-interval test; its lead over the random sets in average target rate ( 0.17 0.17 – 0.35 0.35 ) is essentially unchanged from the uniform random sets ( 0.17 0.17 – 0.38 0.38 ). Its advantage therefore does not come from its layer distribution.
blocks.zh: 跨模式概念神经元集中在后层(每组Quen2.5-Omni情绪中,48起 — 73 % — — 73起位于后层的最后一个季度),而第4.3节的随机组合则在下层之间划一地取出,因此跨模式概念神经元集的优势原则上只能反映其神经元所在的位置。 因此,我们重复对Quen2.5-Omni的情感任务进行方向测试,这个设定与其他控制相同,有五套随机设定,与跨模式概念神经元集在每个层的神经元数量相匹配. 跨模式概念神经元对所有5个标签的5个层相匹配随机集(Rank test p = 1.3 × 10 – 4 p= 1.3\times 10^{-4})进行了排行榜,在预测-间距测试下对其中4个进行了显著分级;它在平均目标速率(0.17 0.17–0.35 0.35)的随机集上领先,与统一随机集(0.17–0.38 0.38)基本没有变化. 因此,它的优势并不来自地层分布.

blocks.en: B.8 DeSTA2.5-Audio Transcript Input
blocks.zh: B.8 DeSTA2.5-Audio 调试输入

blocks.en: To check what DeSTA2.5-Audio’s transcript input (§ 3 ) reveals, we ran its own transcription pipeline (voice-activity detection followed by Whisper-large-v3 decoding) on all 500 clips of each task. For spoken language, every clip receives a transcript, written in the spoken language: judging the transcript’s language by its script (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) or by common function words (European languages), 83 % 83\% match the label ( 100 % 100\% for Chinese and Korean, 62 62 – 89 % 89\% for the European languages and Japanese, where short transcripts often contain no decisive word), a lower bound on how often the answer is readable from text. For animal sounds, 94 % 94\% of clips are rejected by the voice-activity detector and receive an empty transcript, and only about 1 % 1\% of transcripts name the correct animal (e.g. “Woof!”). Emotion clips come from CREMA-D ( Cao et al., 2014 ) , whose fixed sentences are shared across emotions ( 57 % 57\% of transcripts), and MELD ( Poria et al., 2019 ) , TV-show dialogue whose content can occasionally hint at the emotion; gender transcripts contain only the spoken sentence. The transcript thus offers a systematic text route to the answer only for spoken language.
blocks.zh: 为了检查DeSTA2.5-Audio的笔录输入(§ 3)所揭示的内容,我们自己对每项任务的所有500个片段进行了笔录管道(语音活动检测,然后是Whisper-major-v3解码)。 对口语来说,每段片段都收到一份记录稿,用口语写成:用记录稿的脚本(中文、日文、韩文)或共同功能词(欧洲语文)来判断,83 % 符合标签(中文和韩文为100 % , 欧洲语文和日文为62 — 89 % , 欧洲语文和日文为89 % , 简短记录稿往往不包含决定性的词),对于从文本中读取答案的频率来说,难度较低。 对于动物的声音来说,94%的94QQ片段被语音活性探测器所拒绝,并收到一张空的文字记录,只有1%的文字记录将正确的动物取名(如"Woof!"). 情感片段出自于CREMA-D (Cao等,2014年),其固定句子由情感分享(57%57\%),而MELD(Poria等,2019年),电视-放映对话,其内容偶尔可以暗示情感;性别片段只包含口语句. 因此,笔录只为口头语言提供了系统化的文字途径。

blocks.en: B.9 Answer Parsing
blocks.zh: B.9 答复分析

blocks.en: Models are prompted to answer with a single option letter. We take the first character of the stripped, lowercased response as the predicted letter, and additionally accept a leading “(x)” when it is the only option-shaped string in the response, since Audio Flamingo 3 frequently answers in the form “(a) sheep”. A response that yields no letter in { a , b , c , d } \{a,b,c,d\} counts as a parse failure and is scored as incorrect (§ 4.4 ) or as not predicting the target label (§ 4.3 ), identically in every condition. Parse failures are rare. None of the three models produces any at baseline, and at each task’s target decline onset (Table 4 ) cross-modal-neuron deactivation produces none except in Audio Flamingo 3’s gender task ( 2.0 % 2.0\% of responses, accounting for 0.8 0.8 of its 6.2 6.2 percentage-point accuracy drop), so the necessity results reflect changed answers rather than broken outputs. Under contrastive neuron steering (§ 4.3 ), parse failures rise at the largest coefficient, more for cross-modal concept neurons ( 7.9 7.9 – 16.4 % 16.4\% of responses) than for random neurons ( 0.1 0.1 – 4.4 % 4.4\% ). Because a parse failure never counts as predicting the target label, this can only lower the cross-modal concept neurons’ target rate, biasing the comparison against rather than toward our steering results.

blocks.en: Appendix D Reproducibility and Artifact Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 可复制性和活性细节

blocks.en: This appendix collects artifact, licensing, computational, and software details not included in the main text.
blocks.zh: 本附录收录主文未收录的文物,许可证,计算,软件等细节.

blocks.en: D.1 Artifact licenses
blocks.zh: D.1 工艺许可证

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) is released under the Apache-2.0 license. Audio Flamingo 3 ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) ’s code is released under the MIT license; its model weights are for non-commercial research use only. Neither DeSTA2.5-Audio ( Lu et al., 2026 ) nor the SAKURA benchmark ( Yang et al., 2025b ) states an explicit license on its public Hugging Face or GitHub page; we use both strictly for the same non-commercial academic research purpose as their respective release papers.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-Omni-7B(徐等,2025年)以Apache-2.0许可证发行. 音频火焰 3(Ghosh等,2025年)的代码根据麻省理工学院的许可证发布;其模型权重仅供非商业研究使用. DeSTA2.5-Audio(Lu等,2026年)和SAKURA基准(Yang等,2025年b)都没有在其公开的Hugging Face或GitHub页面上注明明确的许可;我们严格地将两者用于与各自发行论文相同的非商业学术研究目的.

blocks.en: D.2 Consistency with intended use
blocks.zh: D.2 与预期用途的一致性

blocks.en: All three models and the SAKURA benchmark are used exactly as released: as pretrained, frozen-at-inference LALMs and an off-the-shelf audio-attribute-recognition evaluation benchmark, respectively. We do not fine-tune, retrain, or redistribute any model weights or benchmark data; our steering and deactivation interventions (§ 4.3 , § 4.4 ) are applied only at inference time for scientific analysis, not as a proposed modification for deployment.
blocks.zh: 所有三种模型和SAKURA基准均按原样使用:分别作为预先训练的、被冻结的LALM和现成的音频属性识别评价基准。 我们没有微调、再培训或重新分配任何模型加权或基准数据;我们的指导和失能干预(§4.3,§4.4)只在科学分析的推断时间适用,而不是作为部署的拟议修改。

blocks.en: D.3 Data screening
blocks.zh: D.3 数据筛选

blocks.en: We do not collect, curate, or redistribute any new data; all audio and labels used in this paper come unmodified from the public SAKURA benchmark (§ 3 ). We therefore did not perform additional screening for personally identifying or offensive content beyond whatever screening SAKURA’s own creators already applied.
blocks.zh: 我们不收集、管理或重新分配任何新数据;本文中使用的所有音频和标签都来自公开的SAKURA基准(第3节)。 因此,除了SAKURA自己的创作者已经申请的筛选之外,我们没有进行额外的筛选,以识别个人身份或冒犯性内容。

blocks.en: D.4 Artifact documentation
blocks.zh: D.4 人工文件

blocks.en: Each of the four SAKURA tasks we use provides 500 audio instances, covering every label it defines: emotion (100 instances per label; 5 labels: angry, disgust, fear, happy, sad), gender (250 per label; female, male), animal sound (9 species, 40–68 instances per label: cat, cow, dog, frog, and sheep at 68 each, crow, hen, pig, and rooster at 40 each), and spoken language (8 languages, 61–64 instances per label: English, French, German, and Spanish at 64 each, Chinese, Italian, Japanese, and Korean at 61 each). SAKURA does not publish speaker demographic information beyond what each task’s own label encodes (e.g. binary gender); we did not have access to any further demographic or geographic characteristics of its speakers.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的4个SAKURA任务都提供了500个音频实例,涵盖它定义的每个标签:情感(每个标签100个实例;5个标签:愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、悲伤)、性别(每个标签250个实例;女性、男性)、动物声音(9个物种,每个标签40-68个实例:猫、牛、狗、蛙和羊,每个标签68个实例;鸦、母鸡、猪和公鸡,每个标签40个实例);口语(每个标签8个语言,61-64个实例:英语、法语、德语和西班牙语,每个标签64个实例:中文、意大利语、日语和韩语,每个标签61个实例)。 SAKURA不会发布超过每个任务自身标签编码(如二进制性别)的演讲者人口信息;我们无法获取其演讲者的任何其他人口或地理特征。

blocks.en: D.5 Data statistics
blocks.zh: D.5 数据统计

blocks.en: For every task, neuron selection and evaluation use a stratified 20%/80% validation/test split over these 500 instances (fixed seed 0; § 2 ), giving approximately 100 validation and 400 test instances per task, proportioned within each label. The overlap analyses (§ 4.1 –§ 4.2 ) choose k k on the validation split and then reselect the neuron sets on the test split. Neuron sets used for interventions are always identified on the validation split, and every result reported in § 4 is computed on the test split; the one choice that uses the test split is the steering neuron-set size (Appendix B.1 ; Limitations).
blocks.zh: 对于每一项任务,神经元选择和评价都使用分级的20%/80%的验证/测试,与这500例(固定种子0;§2)分开,每个任务大约100个验证和400个验证实例,在每个标签内按比例分配。 重叠分析(§ 4.1 –§ 4.2)在验证分解上选择k k,再在测试分解上重新选择神经元集. 用于干预的神经元集总是在验证分出上被识别出,而第4节中报告的每一个结果都是在测试分出上被计算出;使用测试分出的一个选择是方向神经元-设置大小(附录B.1;限制).

blocks.en: D.6 Model size and computational budget
blocks.zh: D.6 模型规模和计算预算

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B’s language backbone (its “Thinker” module) is based on Qwen2.5-7B (7B parameters); we do not use its speech-generating “Talker” module. DeSTA2.5-Audio’s language backbone is Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (8B parameters), frozen throughout its own training and throughout our experiments; its audio encoder is Whisper-large-v3. Audio Flamingo 3’s language backbone is Qwen2.5-7B (7B parameters); its authors do not report a total parameter count including its AF-Whisper audio encoder and adapter. All experiments in this paper are inference-only: we never train or fine-tune any of the three models, only extract their activations or intervene on them (steering, deactivation) at inference time. Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and DeSTA2.5-Audio ran on RTX 3090 GPUs (24GB VRAM); Audio Flamingo 3 ran on RTX A6000 GPUs (48GB VRAM). Reproducing the experiments reported in this paper takes roughly 800 GPU-hours on single GPUs, most of it for the deactivation sweeps (§ 4.4 , Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-Omni-7B语言主干(它的"Thinker"模块)基于Quen2.5-7B(7B参数);我们不使用其能产生语音的"Talker"模块. DeSTA2.5-Audio的语言主干线是Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(8B参数),在自己的训练中和我们的实验中被冷冻;它的音频编码器是Whiper-大-v3. Audio Flamingo 3的语言主干线为Qwen2.5-7B(7B参数);其作者不报告一个总参数计数,包括它的AF-Whisper音频编码器和适配器. 本文中的所有实验都只是推论:我们从未训练或微调过这三种模型中的任何一种,只在推论时提取它们的活化或干预它们(stering, delike). Quen2.5-Omni-7B和DeSTA2.5-Audio运行于RTX 3090 GPU (24GB VRAM); Audio Flamingo 3运行于RTX A6000 GPU (48GB VRAM). 复制本文所报道的实验,在单个GPU上大约需要800个GPU小时,大部分用于去功能扫描(§ 4.4,附录B.1.)。

blocks.en: D.8 Descriptive statistics and single-run vs. averaged results
blocks.zh: D.8 描述性统计和单跑对平均结果

blocks.en: All three models generate with greedy, temperature-free decoding (no sampling), so a given input and neuron intervention deterministically produces the same output; we do not report cross-seed generation variance for this reason. Three components of our pipeline are randomized and are reported accordingly: the Monte Carlo random-overlap baseline in Table 6 (100,000 samples); the five-trial random-neuron deactivation control in § 4.4 , whose curves report the mean across trials; and the five random-neuron control sets per label in § 4.3 , each drawn with a fixed seed; rather than averaging them, the significance tests use their spread as the null distribution (Appendix A.4 ). Every other number reported (accuracy, Jaccard overlap, cosine similarity) is a single deterministic evaluation pass over the fixed test split, not an average or a max over multiple runs.
blocks.zh: 所有三种模型都是用贪婪的,无温度的解码(没有采样)生成的,所以一个给定的输入和神经元的干预定能产生相同的输出;因此我们不报告交叉种子生成的差异. 我们输油管的三个部分是随机的,并相应报告:表6(100 000个样品)中的蒙特卡洛随机重叠基线;第4.4节中的5次随机-中微子失能控制,其曲线报告整个试验的平均值;第4.3节中每个标签的5个随机-中微子控制套件,每套都用固定种子取出;而不是平均,意义测试用其扩散作为无效分配(附录A.4)。 所报告的其他数字(准确性、Jaccard重叠性、同位素相似性)都是单一的确定性评价,通过固定的测试分数,而不是平均或最大数。

blocks.en: D.9 Existing software packages
blocks.zh: D.9 现有软件包

blocks.en: Our implementation uses PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) , Hugging Face Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al., 2020 ) (for the hypergeometric and permutation, t t , and rank significance tests in Appendix A ), NumPy ( Harris et al., 2020 ) , librosa ( McFee et al., 2015 ) (for audio loading and resampling), and Matplotlib ( Hunter, 2007 ) (for figures). Because DeSTA2.5-Audio and Audio Flamingo 3 require conflicting dependencies, each of the three models ran in its own environment: librosa (0.11.0) is common to all three; DeSTA2.5-Audio and Audio Flamingo 3 share PyTorch 2.10.0, SciPy 1.15.3, NumPy 2.2.6, and Matplotlib 3.10.8, while Qwen2.5-Omni instead used PyTorch 2.8.0, SciPy 1.16.3, NumPy 2.3.4, and Matplotlib 3.10.7.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施使用PyTorch(Paszke等人,2019年),Hugging 面部变形器 (Wolf等,2020年),SciPy (Virtanen等,2020年) (关于附录A中的超地几何和地表, t t, 和分级意义测试), NumPy (Harris等,2020年), librosa (McFee等,2015年)(用于音频加载和再生),和Matplotlib (Hunter,2007年)(数字). 由于DeSTA2.5-Audio和Audio Flamingo 3需要相冲突的依赖性,因此这三种型号各自运行在自己的环境中:librosa (0.11.0)是所有三种相通的;DeSTA2.5-Audio和Audio Flamingo 3共用PyTorch 2.1.0,SciPy 1.153,NumPy 2.2.6,和Matplotlib 3.10.8,而Quen2.5-Omni转而使用PyTorch 2.8.0,SciPy 1.163,NumPy 2.3.4和Matplotlib 3.10.7.
